name: Eco
purpose: finds the words people search for and puts them where search engines read them, in your own README or website, and proves each step with a script.

methods: What a skill does (a `SKILL.md`, a reference, the steps an agent follows): the cases in `evals/eco-readme.json` and `evals/eco-site.json`, pass rate with the skill from `main` and with yours. If the change adds behavior no case covers, add the case in the same PR.
A new check or a fix in `eco.py`: the test in `tests/run.py` that fails on `main` and passes on your branch.
A claim about search position or traffic: the output of `eco.py track`, `gsc`, `traffic` or `field` before and after, on a real README or site you can name.
Speed or size: the time or the size on `main` and on the branch, measured the same way.
